scope: The TOPPBase lifecycle of the independently versioned OpenMS4-cli package: command-line parse closure, INI merge and strict update, write commands, file checks, phase-aware exit codes and the run services (progress log type, thread policy, test-mode unique-id seed, processing annotations). Package CLI-1 (C4-CLI-SPEC plus integrator step W1.4). Deliberately not resolved against the Core SDK checkout, except for the Param::update and StringUtils wording the lifecycle reproduces.
method: TOPPBase.cpp read at the cli pin with git show; generic cases executed against the C++ product SDK binaries DTAExtractor and SpectraFilterWindowMower by ../oracle/topp-cli-lifecycle/run.sh in a clean environment (env -i, per-case HOME and cwd, OPENMS_DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK=ON, OPENMS_DATA_PATH=<sdk>/share/OpenMS/4.0.0); the Rust suite asserts each case's exit code and a diagnostic line, and compares the subsection-override output canonically with the C++ output. TOPPBase_test.cpp sections that apply to the native API are transcribed with their literals.
evidence_tier: oracle-generated (tier 1 executed differential) for the tool cases; source review (tier 3) for the transcribed TOPPBase_test.cpp sections; Rust-only (tier 4) for run_io routing, run-phase error mapping and the argument bound
